startup.protocolBody: The app and its converter speak different versions of their protocol (the app expects {app}, the converter answered {engine}). Converting now could produce wrong results, so nothing will run.

startup.missingBody: The converter did not start or did not answer, so nothing will run.
startup.reinstall: This usually means the installation is incomplete or was partly updated. Reinstalling OpenConvert {version} fixes it. Your EPUBs and settings are not affected.
startup.versionBody: This app is version {app}, but the converter it found is version {engine}. They are shipped together and must be the same version, so nothing will run.
startup.versionHint: An update may have been interrupted. Install OpenConvert {app} again. Your EPUBs and settings are not affected.

settings.ai.cardTitle: What AI assistance does, and what it costs
settings.ai.cardBody: Conversion is complete without it. When it's on, a small model on this computer helps with four once-per-book decisions: the book's metadata, ambiguous heading levels, book structure (where front matter and chapters begin), and telling verse and quotations apart from prose.
settings.ai.cardNote: Each result shows how many decisions it made, and the report lists each one next to what the rules alone would have chosen.
settings.ai.label: AI assistance
settings.models.hint: Every model shows its license, and you accept it before its first download. Rows show exactly what the model manager reports.
settings.models.none: No model can be downloaded with this build of the app.
settings.models.noneLine: Conversion works fully without a model.
settings.provider.builtinHint: The app runs the installed model itself. Nothing leaves this computer.
settings.provider.ollamaHint: A local Ollama on this computer, so no consent is needed.
settings.provider.customHint: Any OpenAI-compatible server. A host that isn't this computer needs your consent first.
settings.presets.hint: Change this only if the automatic choice is visibly wrong for a book.
settings.presets.typeHelp: Automatic looks at each PDF and picks the closest type. The report says what it picked.
settings.advanced.maxPagesHelp: Longer PDFs stop with a message instead of converting.
settings.advanced.maxMemoryHelp: Raise this for very large documents, such as high-resolution atlases.
settings.advanced.invalid: Enter a whole number of at least {min}.
settings.packs.ocrNote: This version uses Tesseract installed on your system. Scanned pages are kept as images until it is installed.
settings.packs.validationNote: Arrives after 1.0. It will run the full EPUBCheck after the built-in check; the built-in check always runs.
settings.language.help: Follows your system unless you choose one. Applies at once, no restart.
settings.language.note: Language names are written in their own language.
settings.network.hint: Every connection the app and its engine made, recorded on this computer. A conversion appears here only when AI assistance asked a model — on this computer or at an endpoint you allowed.
settings.network.noneLine: Nothing has connected yet. A connection is recorded when you download a model or a pack, when you check for updates, and — with AI assistance on — each time a conversion asks the provider you chose.
settings.about.reportHelp: Creates a diagnostic bundle you review first. Nothing is sent.
settings.about.updatesHelp: Asks GitHub whether a newer version exists, only when you press the button. An update is installed only after its signature has been verified.
settings.about.updateReady: OpenConvert {version} is available. Its signature has been verified.
settings.about.installFailed: The update could not be installed. Nothing was changed.
update.failed.no_key: This build cannot verify updates, so it does not look for them.
update.failed.bad_signature: An update was found, but its signature did not verify, so it was not installed.
update.failed.too_large: An update was found, but it is larger than any OpenConvert installer, so it was not downloaded.
update.failed.no_platform: There is no update for this system yet.
update.failed.bad_manifest: The update information could not be read. Try again later.
update.failed.network: Could not reach GitHub. Check the connection and try again.
bundle.title: Diagnostic bundle
bundle.notSent: OpenConvert did not send this anywhere. Check what is inside before you share it. The report and event log can contain text from your document.
bundle.what.report.json: The conversion report: counts, warnings, ledger, timing
bundle.what.events.ndjson: The converter's event log for this job (stages, progress, warnings)
bundle.what.versions.txt: The app's and the converter's versions
bundle.what.system.txt: Operating system, architecture and core count
bundle.excluded: Not included: the PDF, the EPUB, your settings file, any API key.
error.passwordWrong: That password didn't open the file. Try again.
editor.metaHelp: Changes are saved as corrections for this book. Fix and rebuild re-runs only the last steps, from cache. It takes a few seconds and does not analyse the PDF again.
editor.title: Title
editor.author: Author {n}
editor.tocHelp: Rename a heading or change its level. Changes are saved as corrections for this book and rebuilt from cache.
editor.heading: Heading, page {page}
editor.noHeadings: This book has no headings to review.
result.rebuilt: rebuilt in {s} s with your corrections
result.applied: Applied: {changes}. The rest of the book is unchanged.
settings.advanced.cacheHelp.one: {size} for 1 book. It holds text from your documents so rebuilds take seconds.
settings.advanced.cacheHelp.other: {size} for {n} books. It holds text from your documents so rebuilds take seconds.
settings.advanced.cacheEmpty: Empty. While the app is open it holds text from the books you convert, so rebuilds take seconds; it is emptied at every start.
settings.cache.title: Clear the cache?
settings.cache.body.one: The cache holds text from the documents you converted ({size}, 1 book). Clearing it deletes that text from this computer.
settings.cache.body.other: The cache holds text from the documents you converted ({size}, {n} books). Clearing it deletes that text from this computer.
settings.cache.small: Your EPUB files are not touched. Afterwards, Fix and rebuild re-reads the PDF, which takes longer the first time.
firstrun.title: Set up AI assistance
firstrun.hint: Downloads {name} ({license}): {size}, ~{ram} RAM while converting, a few extra seconds per book. Conversion works fully without this. You can keep converting while it downloads.

settings.ai.noTasks: In this build no decision has passed its evaluation for any language yet, so books convert as they would with this off. Each report still lists what would have been asked.
settings.ai.mode.fastHint: Quicker; the model gives short answers.
settings.ai.mode.qualityHint: Slower; the model thinks each answer through and checks it twice. Works with every model.

ai.why.server_failed: The model server did not start.
ai.why.no_endpoint: The custom endpoint is not a web address.
ai.why.plain_http: The custom endpoint is not on this computer and does not use https.

provider.consented: You allowed document text to be sent to {host}.
provider.notUrl: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
provider.testing: Asking the endpoint what it is…

error.consent: Sending text to another computer needs your consent

settings.output.libraryOff: Off: each book is saved next to its PDF.
settings.output.folderHelp: A book is never saved over one that is already there; the new one gets a number instead.
